Subject: Source review request for custom packaging buyer resources

Hello,

I am sharing a claim-bounded source index from MUGE PACKAGING for editors who maintain packaging supplier directories, buyer guides or sourcing resource pages.

The source index connects official MUGE PACKAGING pages with public Source Packs for custom paper tubes, custom cosmetic packaging, rigid gift boxes and custom packaging buyer/RFQ questions across the United States, Canada, the UK and Dubai.

Source index: https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/seo-geo-7-day-keyword-cluster-source-index-2026-06-16.html
Public Gist mirror: https://gist.github.com/mugepackage-gif/ac67cb72f43488b1e1f3739f0ccf37f4
GitHub Release: https://github.com/mugepackage-gif/muge-packaging-resources/releases/tag/v2026.06.16-seo-geo-7-day-cluster-source-index

Please treat this only as official source-path material for editorial review. It is not a request to call MUGE a verified supplier, market leader, ranked company, fixed-MOQ provider, fixed-lead-time provider, lowest-price provider, customer-case holder or compliance-guarantee source.

If useful for your readers, you may reference the official MUGE source paths where they fit your page context.

Best regards,
MUGE PACKAGING
https://mugepackaging.com
